skills.name: Stalagmite
skills.description: Enemy 8% All In trong 8s, stack đến 5 (max 40% All In)
usageNotes: Self có 25% cơ hội tăng 275% Magi Out trong 2s - “Magnitude”
Enemy có 50% khả năng bị Stun trong 4s khi có “Magnitude”
Note: Skill gây 390% Spell DMG khi có “Magnitude”.
skills.officialDescription: Causes a stalagmite to erupt out of the ground at your opponents feet, dealing damage and crippling their defenses. Applies Bruised to the target, increasing all incoming damage in by 8% for 8 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times. Has a 25% chance to apply Magnitude for 2 seconds. If Magnitude is applied, immediately has a 50% chance to stun for 4 seconds.
wikiNotes: Has a 25% chance to apply Magnitude, which increases all outgoing magic damage by 275% for 2 seconds. Magnitude in turn, also has a 25% chance to apply per ally affected by Echoing Earth or Land's Embrace.
If Magnitude is applied, deals 390% Spell DPS and adds a 50% stun chance to the effect.

skills.name: Echoing Earth
usageNotes: Self có 25% cơ hội tăng 275% Magi Out trong 2s - “Magnitude”
Allies -20% Mana Cost trong 10s khi có “Magnitude”
skills.officialDescription: Harness the residual energy of great battles from ages past trapped beneath the surface. Applies Resonance and Dissonance, which increases haste and crit chance by 30% for the caster and up to 6 friendly targets while improving mana regain. Lasts for 10 seconds. Has a 25% chance to apply Magnitude for 2 seconds. If Magnitude is applied, mana costs are immediately reduced for you and your party by 20% for 10 seconds.
wikiNotes: Resonance and Dissonance last for 10 seconds.
Dissonance restores 10 mana for every ally affected by a self-targeting buff, including the caster.

Has a 25% chance to apply Magnitude, which increases all outgoing magic damage by 275% for 2 seconds. Magnitude in turn, also has a 25% chance to apply per ally affected by Echoing Earth or Land's Embrace.
If Magnitude is applied, applies Magnitude Mana, which reduces mana costs by 20% for the caster and up to 4 friendly targets for 10 seconds.
